# AI Nexus × Neon AI Studio – full profile

Last updated: 2026-11-11
Website: https://neonaistudio.in/

## Who we are

AI Nexus × Neon AI Studio is a remote creative and technology agency, also known simply as "AI Nexus" or "Neon AI Studio". It works as an AI ad agency and a full-service digital marketing agency. One team produces AI video ads and videos, edits video, designs brands, builds websites and mobile apps, runs SEO and social media marketing, builds AI chatbots and automations, and provides web hosting with HTTPS security. The studio is based in Maharashtra, India, and delivers all work online to clients anywhere in the world. Its slogan is "Ideas into Impact".

## Countries served

India, United Arab Emirates (including Dubai), Kuwait, Luxembourg, Japan, United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Germany, Singapore, Ireland, New Zealand, South Africa, and worldwide. Communication is in English (Hindi and Marathi are also available), with time-zone-friendly hand-offs.

## How to order

1. Message on WhatsApp: +91 9226520552 (https://wa.me/919226520552), or email moreshwar1234bhonde@gmail.com.
2. Describe what you need (service, length, deadline, references).
3. You get a confirmed price and timeline, then the work starts.
4. Files, links or the finished website are delivered online. Short videos are usually ready in 24–48 hours.
On the website, every plan has a "Get Plan" button that opens WhatsApp with the plan already filled in.

## Plans and prices (Indian rupees, INR)

- STANDARD video plan: 599 INR per video, up to 30/32 seconds.
- PREMIUM video plan: 1019 INR per video, up to 60/65 seconds.
- Diamond Plan Unlimited (web hosting): 199 INR per month on a 48-month term (9,552 INR for 48 months), renews at 649 INR per month. Unlimited websites and mailboxes, ecommerce, 50 GB NVMe storage, Python and Node.js.
- Gold Premium (web hosting): 139 INR per month on a 24-month term, renews at 449 INR per month. 3 websites, 20 GB SSD storage, weekly backups, CDN, Python, 2 mailboxes.
- Secured System (HyperText Transfer Protocol Secure, HTTPS): 2999 INR. SSL certificate set-up and automatic renewal, padlock in the browser, encrypted connection.
Longer films, bulk packs and custom projects are quoted on WhatsApp.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What services does AI Nexus × Neon AI Studio offer?
A: AI video ads and AI video production, video editing and animation, website and ecommerce development, mobile app development, logo, branding and graphic design, SEO and digital marketing, social media marketing, AI chatbots and automation, and web hosting with HTTPS security. The full list is at https://neonaistudio.in/services.html.

Q: Which countries do you work with?
A: We work with clients worldwide, fully remotely. Key markets include India, Dubai and the UAE, Kuwait, Luxembourg, Japan, the USA, the UK, Canada, Australia, Germany, Singapore, Ireland, New Zealand and South Africa.

Q: How do I order a service?
A: Message us on WhatsApp at +91 9226520552 (or email moreshwar1234bhonde@gmail.com) with what you need. We confirm the brief, price and timeline, then start work. Every plan on the website has a "Get Plan" button that opens WhatsApp with the plan pre-filled.

Q: Is delivery remote?
A: Yes. Everything is delivered online — files, links and websites are shared over WhatsApp, email or cloud links, with English-first communication and time-zone-friendly hand-offs.

Q: How much does an AI video cost?
A: The STANDARD plan is 599 INR per video (up to 30/32 seconds) and the PREMIUM plan is 1019 INR per video (up to 60/65 seconds). Longer films and bulk packs are quoted on WhatsApp.

Q: What are your web hosting and security prices?
A: Diamond Plan Unlimited hosting is 199 INR per month on a 48-month term (renews at 649 INR/month). Gold Premium hosting is 139 INR per month on a 24-month term (renews at 449 INR/month). The Secured System (HTTPS/SSL set-up) is 2999 INR.

Q: How fast is delivery?
A: Short videos are typically delivered in 24–48 hours. Websites, apps and branding projects get a timeline when the brief is confirmed.

Q: Can you build websites and apps for international businesses?
A: Yes. We build responsive websites, ecommerce stores (Shopify, WordPress, WooCommerce) and Android/iOS apps for businesses in any country, and can add SEO, hosting and HTTPS.
